entities.summary: Neferirkare Pepi III was an ancient Egyptian king of the Eighth Dynasty during the early First Intermediate Period. According to egyptologists Kim Ryholt, Jürgen Beckerath, and Darrell Baker, he was the 17th and final king of the Eighth Dynasty. Many scholars consider Neferirkare to have been the last king of the Old Kingdom, which came to an end with the 8th Dynasty.
